author: KEXP
description: Hypnotic textures and emotional depth merge to create the transfixing folk sound of The Barr Brothers. In-studio with host DJ Morgan, the band share a celestial performance of "Burn Card" and more from across their discography.
title: The Barr Brothers perform "Burn Card" & more Live on KEXP
